CHECK BEFORE YOU ACCEPT.
THE RIGHT CHECK, RIGHT ON TIME

Why Does a Brand-New Car Still Need a PDI?

A car looking brand-new from the outside doesn't necessarily mean it is in perfect condition.

Before reaching you, a vehicle may have been stored for months, transported from another dealership, suffered accidental damage during transit, or developed a manufacturing defect. In some cases, repairs or part replacements may even have been carried out at the dealership before delivery.

This is where AUTO CHECK makes the difference.

Our professionally trained inspectors have the technical expertise to examine the actual vehicle being delivered to you. We check for signs of previous repairs, replaced components, paint inconsistencies, manufacturing defects, transportation damage and functional issues.

Our inspection covers:

Body & Exterior Inspection
Paint & Finish Inspection
Mechanical & Underbody Inspection
Electrical & Features Inspection
Manufacturing Defect & Repair Check
Vehicle Identity & Documentation Verification

You are paying the full price for a brand-new vehicle. You deserve to receive one that meets your expectations, not a vehicle with undisclosed damage or unresolved defects.

Don't rely only on the new-car tag. Let AUTO CHECK inspect the actual car before you accept delivery.

OUR DETAILED INSPECTION CHECKLIST

300+ points.
One careful look.

We organise the inspection into clear sections so you can understand what is being checked. Tap each section to see the checklist.

01 Exterior & body inspection50+ points
  • Body panels, paint finish and colour match
  • Panel gaps, alignment and fitment
  • Dents, scratches and surface defects
  • Rust, corrosion and paint irregularities
  • Glass, mirrors, lights and badges
  • Bumpers, cladding and external fittings
02 Engine & mechanical inspection40+ points
  • Engine starting, idling and overall condition
  • Fluid levels: engine oil, coolant, brake fluid and washer fluid
  • Belts, hoses, pipes and connections
  • Engine or transmission leak observations
  • Unusual noises, vibration and performance observations
  • Battery, charging system and visible condition
03 Tyres, wheels & braking system35+ points
  • Tyre brand, manufacturing date and condition
  • Tread depth and wear pattern
  • Sidewall cuts, bulges and damage
  • Spare wheel, tools and air pressure
  • Brake pads, discs, calipers and lines where accessible
  • Wheel rims, nuts and overall fitment
04 Electrical & lighting system40+ points
  • Headlamps, tail lamps, DRLs and fog lamps
  • Indicators, reverse and number plate lamps
  • Horn, wipers and washer system
  • Power windows, ORVMs and central locking
  • Infotainment, USB, charging and connectivity
  • Electrical wiring, fuses and overall function
05 Interior & cabin inspection40+ points
  • Dashboard, seats, upholstery and fitment
  • AC and heating performance, cooling check
  • Infotainment, speakers and control response
  • Seat belts, buckles and pretensioners
  • Switches, buttons and interior trims
  • Cabin odour, cleanliness and overall finish
06 Features & model-specific equipment20+ points
  • Reverse camera, parking sensors and surround view
  • Sunroof or panoramic roof, if equipped
  • Keyless entry, start/stop and remote functions
  • Drive modes, terrain and vehicle settings
  • ADAS and safety assist features where available
  • Model-specific accessories and fitted equipment
07 Underbody & structural checks30+ points
  • Suspension components and mounting
  • Underbody condition and rust check
  • Chassis, cross members and reinforcement
  • Fluid leaks (engine, transmission, brake, AC)
  • Exhaust system, muffler and mounts
  • Fuel lines, hoses and underbody protection
08 Dashboard warning lights & electronics25+ points
  • Instrument cluster self-check
  • Warning lights including engine, ABS and airbag
  • Sensor, display and indicator functionality
  • ECU scan for stored error codes if required and available
  • Electrical system health and communication
  • Calibration and system response observations
09 Documentation & delivery readiness20+ points
  • VIN (chassis) and engine number verification
  • Manufacturing date and model details
  • Registration and insurance document check
  • Jack, tool kit, spare wheel and accessories
  • Owner's manual, warranty and service details
  • Final condition photographs and inspection report

GOOD TO KNOW

Questions before you book?

Some quick answers about vehicle inspections.

What is a Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI)?

A Pre-Delivery Inspection means checking your new car thoroughly before you accept its delivery. Our experienced inspection team checks whether everything is genuine, new and working properly. We look for manufacturing defects, previous repairs, replaced parts, signs of rectification at the dealership, and even minor changes in the vehicle's condition or history. The goal is simple: make sure you know exactly what you are accepting before taking delivery of your new car.

Should I inspect a brand-new car?

Absolutely. A car looking brand-new from the outside doesn't necessarily mean it is free from defects or previous damage. During transportation or movement between dealerships, a vehicle may experience accidents, scratches or other damage. It could also be an older stock vehicle, have manufacturing defects, flood-related concerns or previous repairs carried out before delivery. Sometimes, a particular model or variant is transferred from another dealership, even 50 km away. You pay the full price for a brand-new car, so you deserve to know its actual condition. That's where AUTO CHECK PDI comes in. With our technical expertise, we inspect the vehicle for signs of repairs, replaced parts, repainting, manufacturing defects, transportation damage and other irregularities. We identify and document our findings before you accept delivery. Don't just trust that the car is new. Make sure it has been properly inspected.

Can you inspect a car for flood or water damage?

Yes. AUTO CHECK PDI has the technical expertise to inspect vehicles for flood or water damage through a dedicated 30-point flood inspection.

Can you identify whether an odometer has been tampered with?

Yes. AUTO CHECK PDI follows a dedicated 10-point odometer inspection to identify whether a vehicle's odometer has been tampered with.

Do you provide New Car PDI?

Yes. We provide professional Pre-Delivery Inspection for new cars before you accept delivery from the showroom. Fixed charges: ₹1,500.

Do you provide Pre-Owned Car PDI?

Yes. We provide detailed inspections of pre-owned cars before purchase. Fixed charges: ₹2,000.

What do I receive after inspection?

After the inspection is completed, we provide a detailed PDF report with photographs and recorded findings.
